animationDuration.name: Animation Duration
animationDuration.description: Duration of the tooltip animation in milliseconds.

animationEasing.name: Animation Easing
animationEasing.description: Easing function for the tooltip animation.

trigger.name: Trigger
trigger.description: The type of event that triggers the tooltip.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Gap between the tooltip and the active position.

filterNull.name: Filter Null
filterNull.description: If true, null and undefined values are filtered out of the payload.

isAnimationActive.name: Is Animation Active
isAnimationActive.description: Whether tooltip animation is active. 'auto' respects the user's prefers-reduced-motion setting.

includeHidden.name: Include Hidden
includeHidden.description: Whether to include hidden series in the tooltip payload.

useTranslate3d.name: Use Translate3d
useTranslate3d.description: If true, use CSS translate3d instead of translate for positioning.

separator.name: Separator
separator.description: The separator between the name and value in the tooltip.
